summary: House Republicans have introduced a bill that would impose a 10-year moratorium on states regulating artificial intelligence, aiming to create a uniform federal framework. The bill, dubbed 'big, beautiful,' is part of a broader effort to preempt state-level AI laws. The proposal has sparked debate over states' rights and consumer protections.

claims.text: House Republicans have proposed a bill that would ban US states from regulating AI for 10 years.
claims.evidence_quote: House Republicans include a 10-year ban on US states regulating AI in 'big, beautiful' bill

claims.text: The bill is described as 'big, beautiful' by its proponents.
The bill aims to create a uniform federal framework for AI regulation.
